p.espaces.cu_d5: EORI number (for import or export business in the EU)
p.espaces.cu_d6: Depending on the product: Sanitary or phytosanitary certificate, license, CE standard
p.espaces.cu_i1: EXW: Everything is taken by the buyer from the seller's factory.
p.espaces.cu_i2: FCA: The seller handed over the export-duty-free product to the buyer's craftsman.
p.espaces.cu_i3: FOB: Seller loads goods on ship; then risk and cost to consumer.
p.espaces.cu_i4: CIF: Seller pays the goods at the port of arrival, including transportation costs and insurance.
p.espaces.cu_i5: DDP: Seller delivers the goods to destination, buyer pays import duties.
p.espaces.cu_i6: DDP: The seller pays everything, including import duties.
p.espaces.cu_ban: Prohibited or regulated everywhere: weapons, drugs, counterfeits, protected species (CITS), some medicines.
p.espaces.cu_src: Source: ICCS (Incoterms 2020), ITC, European Commission, Duane Gove, Free.

p.espaces.ds_d: Sell without stock: find a supplier, set a realistic price, stay within the law.
p.espaces.ds_sub: Dropshipping means selling products that the supplier sends directly to your customer. It's easy to get started, but you're responsible for the sales.
p.espaces.ds_s1: Choose a product that is authorized in your customer's country: no counterfeit, no regulated, no approved.
p.espaces.ds_s2: Find a supplier (here "Holding/Supplier" list or holding platform) and order samples before selling.
p.espaces.ds_s3: Set the real price: product, shipping, customs, VAT in the customer's country, payment fees and returns.
p.espaces.ds_s4: Tell your customers the actual delivery time.
p.espaces.ds_s5: Register your business: business status, VAT and taxes in your country (see business rules).
p.espaces.ds_s6: Respect consumers' rights: clear prices including taxes, right of return, guarantee, data protection.
